svg.title: MedAgentGym overview with biomedical metadata, agentic trajectory sampling, LLM-friendly commands, environment feedbacks, sandbox, and workflow trajectory.
svg.desc: Base-frame inventory: f01 contains Bio-Medical Metadata title, 7.4M Data count, four icon-label pairs for EHR Data, Clinical Notes, Genomics Data, and Drugs. f02 contains Bio-Medical Data Science Tasks title, 129 Tasks and 72K Instances, and four task icon-label pairs. f03 contains Agentic Traj. Sampling with robot LLM Agent box, dashed Trajectories box, a vertical downward arrow, and curved orange return trajectory. f04 contains MedAgentGym title and two inner panels: LLM-friendly commands and environment feedbacks, with two-column icon-label lists. f05 contains a Sandbox stack card with Docker logo, Terminal row, filesystem tree rows and labels. f06 contains the bottom dashed trajectory/workflow strip with step boxes, icons, labels, ellipsis, reward, and connecting arrows. Confirmed SAM mappings are applied after native construction: source crops retain original coordinates with transform translate(0 0); replacements overlay only covered icon constructions while preserving outer frames, text and borders.

g.desc: Origin at upper-left title; conduction moves right to count, downward to left-column icons, then right-column icon-label pairs. Section uses two-column symmetry with titles aligned at top.

Origin is the two-line task title; conduction proceeds right to counts, down to biomedical SWE and biostatistics, then right to predictive modeling and biomedical analysis. Two columns of icon-label pairs align horizontally.

Origin is Agentic Traj. Sampling title; conduction goes downward to robot/LLM Agent box and then downward to dashed Trajectories box. The inner content has vertical symmetry centered near x=728, with an orange return curve from trajectory area back to agent.

Origin is the MedAgentGym title, then downward into the command panel and feedback panel. Each panel is two-column equipartition: left column has request/edit or data/error, right column has evaluate/debug or code-results/history.

Origin is Docker/Sandbox heading; conduction moves downward through terminal row and filesystem tree. The tree is left-aligned with icons and monospaced labels, with child folders indented under Filesystem.

Origin is the leftmost BioMed DS Question step; conduction proceeds strictly rightward through request, data, coding, errors, debug, ellipsis, results, and reward. Step boxes are horizontally aligned along one center line and connected by straight arrows.

Replacement rationales: P-board assets match the specific icon crops in the original figure. Each image uses source_crop coordinates directly; constructions listed in data-plus-replaces are the covered native SVG drafts. Outer frames, labels, titles, arrows, and borders remain native and are not replaced.
